description: This file defines the interface for a chat grain in an Orleans-based distributed system, including serialization support for XDocument objects.

classes.name: XDocumentSerialization
classes.description: A custom serializer and copier for XDocument objects to enable serialization within Orleans.

classes.name: XDocumentSurrogate
classes.description: A surrogate struct for serializing XDocument instances as strings.

methods.name: GetChat
methods.description: Returns the current content of the chat room as an XDocument.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Adds a new post to the chat, identified by a GUID, with user and text content.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific post identified by GUID.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits a specific post identified by GUID, updating its text.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate back into an XDocument.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an XDocument into its surrogate form for serialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an XDocument.
